name: @w6w-apps/lofty
description: Manage Lofty real-estate CRM leads, tasks and notes, register webhooks, read team members, send SMS and email, and pull communication history.

w6w.longDescription:
Lofty (formerly Chime) is a real-estate CRM, and this app covers the record-keeping a property workflow runs on: leads and their assignment, follow-up tasks, notes, and the appointments attached to a lead. It brings the whole lead lifecycle into a workflow — create a lead when a form is submitted, move it through a pipeline stage, log a note after a conversation, and schedule the follow-up task that keeps it moving.

Leads can be searched by stage, source, assignee, tags, segments and contact details, so a workflow can act on a filtered set rather than pulling the whole book. Communication is covered on both sides: send SMS and email from the connection's own Lofty number and mailbox, and read the SMS, email and call history back for a lead. Team-wide vocabulary — tags, custom-field definitions and lead pipelines — is readable too, so downstream steps can use the same stages and fields the Lofty account does.

The app also registers webhooks, so a workflow can react to lead events instead of polling for them, and reads the organization structure and team-member list for routing and ownership decisions. It is the app to reach for when a workflow needs to read or write the leads a real-estate team works, without hand-rolling calls against Lofty's Open API.
